key.name: wallpaper
key.summary: Directory of the active Wallpaper Engine project (contains project.json)

key.name: monitor-wallpapers
key.summary: JSON object of project directories for individual displays, keyed by connector name; other displays show the default wallpaper

key.name: fit
key.summary: How video and scene wallpapers are scaled to the display

key.name: when-focused
key.summary: What playback does while a window is on screen

key.name: when-maximized
key.summary: What playback does while every display is covered by a window that fills most of it

key.name: when-fullscreen
key.summary: What playback does while every display is covered by a window that fills all of it

key.name: when-audio
key.summary: What playback does while another application plays audio

key.name: when-on-battery
key.summary: What playback does while the computer runs on battery power

key.name: gpu
key.summary: Name of the GPU wallpapers are rendered on, as switcheroo-control reports it; empty for the default

key.name: fps
key.summary: Frame rate limit of scene and web wallpapers

key.name: render-scale
key.summary: Resolution scene wallpapers are rendered at, in percent of their own

key.name: particles
key.summary: Draw the particle effects of scene wallpapers

key.name: system-background
key.summary: Set a still of the wallpaper as Nekoland's wallpaper, for the lock screen, the overview and the menu bar

key.name: previous-background
key.summary: Nekoland's wallpaper setting to put back when the wallpaper stops: a path, an empty string for none, or nothing while none is kept

key.name: playlist
key.summary: Project directories of the wallpapers to rotate through

key.name: rotation-interval
key.summary: Minutes between playlist wallpapers; 0 turns rotation off

key.name: rotation-shuffle
key.summary: Pick the next playlist wallpaper at random

key.name: language
key.summary: Language of the picker window; empty to follow the system

key.name: paused
key.summary: Playback is paused by the user

key.name: extra-dirs
key.summary: Additional directories scanned for wallpaper projects

key.name: scene-renderer
key.summary: Path to the linux-wallpaperengine binary; empty to look it up in PATH

key.name: user-properties
key.summary: JSON object of per-wallpaper property overrides, keyed by project directory
